subject: english
question:
Select the word that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.

People with generous hearts can see the __intrinsic__ value in something which looks worthless to others.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Extraneous'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **intrinsic** means **' ****belonging to something as part of its nature'**.
 
• The word '**Extraneous'** means **' of external origin'**.

 Thus, the correct answer is - **Extraneous.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The meaning of other words are as follow:-

 
• The word** impertinent **means **' not showing respect to somebody who is older and more important'.**
 
• The word **genuine** means** ' that can be trusted'**.
 
• The word **unrelated** means ' **not connected in any way'.**
